recognize_zh: 在淡粉紅、水腫狀的基質中散布大量核偏心、染色質呈車輪狀、細胞質略嗜雙色的漿細胞，偶見雙核，屬於伴隨肉芽腫病灶的反應性漿細胞增生。
features: Numerous plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and clumped (clock-face) chromatin
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, some with a perinuclear pale zone
Cells loosely dispersed in an edematous, pale eosinophilic stroma rather than compact sheets
No overt nuclear pleomorphism or prominent nucleoli; a small vessel crosses the right side
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a dense population of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse clock-face chromatin, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, including occasional binucleated forms. The cells are dispersed in an edematous eosinophilic stroma with small vessels. Significant nuclear atypia and prominent nucleoli are not evident. In the setting of granulomatous inflammation, this likely represents a reactive plasmacytosis; kappa/lambda ISH or immunohistochemistry is needed to confirm polytypism and exclude a plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Shows clonal light chain restriction by kappa/lambda staining, often with compact sheets and nuclear atypia, and an M-protein.
Contains a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with monotypic IgM and MYD88 L265P.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Has CD20-positive monocytoid B cells accompanying monotypic plasma cells.
Shows increased IgG4-positive plasma cells or characteristic lymph node/vascular changes with polytypic light chains.
